{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out invalid customer_age values (negative or zero)
# The data shows that -1 is used as a sentinel value for missing or invalid age
valid_sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] > 0]

# Check how many rows were removed
print(f"Rows with invalid age (age <= 0): {len(sales_df) - len(valid_sales_df)}")
print(f"Valid rows: {len(valid_sales_df)}")

# Now compute mean age of customers who converted, using only valid age data
converted_customers = valid_sales_df[valid_sales_df['converted'] == 1]
mean_age_converted = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of customers who converted (valid age only): {mean_age_converted}")"}
